Cyber Readiness

Visibility is everything. We provide intelligence that supports decision-making and reduces exposure before it becomes a liability.

Operational Continuity

Security should move with the business, not against it. We integrate protection into operations without gaps, disruptions, or wasted time.

Rapid Response

When an attack happens, timing defines the outcome. Our response ensures threats are neutralized before they escalate.

Proactive Security

Cyber risks evolve and so must defenses. We design strategies that respond to change and keep organizations ahead.

Our Process

Identify Fortify Contain Challenge
Structured Risk Assessment

IDENTIFY

A defined process. Each assessment follows a clear methodology built from decades of frontline experience.

Key Process:

Deep Discovery

Map assets, dependencies and operational priorities.

Technical Scoping

Analyze architecture, configurations and threat exposure.

Risk Mapping

Highlight real exposures aligned with business impact.

Multidisciplinary Analysis

Integrate CTI, red team, blue team and threat modeling.

OUTCOME

Fully led by our team with minimal reliance on internal staff. We deliver a complete, actionable understanding of risk, structured, defensible and aligned to business priorities.

Systematic Defense Hardening

FORTIFY

Translates assessment findings into a clear remediation plan with defined phases.

Key Process:

Prioritization

Rank exposures by operational impact and threat likelihood.

Design

Develop targeted controls for cloud, identity, endpoint and network layers.

Implementation

Deploy improvements with minimal client disruption.

Validation

Test effectiveness and document operational improvements.

OUTCOME

Our team leads all execution, involving internal teams only when essential. We deliver hardened environments, minimize attack surfaces, and ensure resilient operational continuity.

Disciplined Incident Handling

CONTAIN

A structured incident response process informed by managing high-profile breaches.

Key Process:

Triage and Scope

Rapid identification of incident parameters.

Containment

Immediate action to isolate and neutralize the threat.

Forensics

Evidence collection and root cause analysis.

Remediation and Recovery

Restore stability and close the gaps.

OUTCOME

Minimal internal disruption. Our team manages the response with precision and control. The result: contained impact, uninterrupted continuity and a clear path to resolution.

Structured Validation

CHALLENGE

A formal and repeatable process to test defenses under realistic conditions.

Key Process:

Planning

Define scope, objectives and threat emulation strategy.

Execution

Conduct red team simulations, tabletop exercises and control reviews.

Analysis

Map results to real world tactics and operational priorities.

Reporting

Deliver clear findings and remediation guidance.

OUTCOME

Fully managed by our team with minimal burden on internal resources. The outcome: validated defenses, documented assurance and readiness you can confidently stand behind.

CASE STUDY

Advanced Persistent Threat at a Global Financial Institution

Read the case study

The Problem

A global financial institution was targeted by a sophisticated nation-state advanced persistent threat using compromised administrative credentials.

The Solution

Rapid containment, forensic investigation, proactive threat hunting, and implementation of tailored cybersecurity improvements.

Result

Successfully neutralized the threat, secured operational continuity, and significantly strengthened the institution’s cybersecurity resilience.
